description: This file defines a Razor Page model for handling error display in an ASP.NET Core application. It contains properties for request identification and a method to initialize data during page load.

classes.name: ErrorModel
classes.description: A Razor Page model class for handling application errors, providing the request ID and whether to display it.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Initializes the RequestId property with the current activity ID or the HTTP context trace identifier when the page is accessed.
